name: components_signal_harness_smoke
source:
// Harness smoke fixture: a chained user-defined signal circuit with hand-derived
// values (2 -> x3 -> x5 = 30) plus a broadcast node.
// EXPECT g1.in.sig = 2
// EXPECT g2.out.sig = 30
// EXPECT b.out.sig = 10 tol 1e-9
COMPONENT KConst(out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k
END
COMPONENT KGain(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k * in.sig
END
KConst SRC(k=2)
KGain  G1(k=3)
KGain  G2(k=5)
KGain  B(k=5)
connect(SRC.out, G1.in, B.in)
connect(G1.out, G2.in)
